segments.text:
THe grace which we must desire, is the spirit of grace and deprecations. Zachar. 12.10. which is that gift of the holy Ghost, whereby we are inabled to call to God for the pardon of our sinnes. A man hauing offended the laws of a prince, and beeing in daunger of death, will neuer be at quiet till he haue gotten a pardon: euen so they which feele and see them sinnes hauing this
spirit, are so mooued, that they can neuer be at rest, till in praier they be eased of the burthen of their sinnes. A man may, I graunt, babble and speake many wordes, but he shall neuer pray effectually, before he haue this spirit of praier to make him crie, Abba, father. For worldly commodities all can pray: but learne to pray for the want of Christ.
